Yes, straps are a fine tool here. Your back is the muscle you're trying to train on deadlifts, and if your grip taps out first, the back never gets its full work.

A common approach is to do your lighter and medium sets without straps so your grip keeps getting trained, and strap up for the heavy top sets or higher-rep work where grip is the limiter. Mixed grip or a hook grip also helps a lot before you reach for straps, and holding the last rep for a few seconds is a simple way to build grip over time.

If you're in a meet or a program that needs raw grip, that changes things, so tell me if that's you.
